title: 1207 Content Writer / SEO Copywriter (Part-Time)
description:
Intetics Inc., a global technology company providing custom software application development, distributed professional teams, software product quality assessment, and digital transformation solutions, is looking for a German Content Writer / SEO Copywriter to support content creation and optimization activities on a part-time basis.

About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive content specialist who can create high-quality content in both German and English. The ideal candidate combines strong writing skills with a solid understanding of SEO principles and is capable of producing engaging, well-structured content tailored to different audiences and business needs.

Project Details

  • Duration: 3 months
  • Workload: 1-2 hours per day
  • Languages: German B2+ and English B2+
  • Engagement: Part-time

Responsibilities

  • Create and edit content for clients' websites, including:
    • Landing pages
    • Category pages
    • Product pages
    • Blog articles
  • Prepare content for external publications, including guest posts and other off-site placements.
  • Optimize content according to SEO best practices while naturally incorporating target keywords.
  • Adapt tone of voice, structure, and messaging for different clients, industries, and audiences.
  • Review, edit, and proofread content to ensure accuracy, consistency, grammar, and editorial quality.
  • Conduct research on unfamiliar topics and transform findings into reader-friendly, valuable content.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure content aligns with project objectives and SEO strategies.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

  • German and English language proficiency at B2 level or higher with excellent writing skills in both languages.
  • Proven ability to create clear, engaging, and well-structured content for different formats and audiences.
  • Good understanding of SEO fundamentals, including:
    • Keyword research
    • Search intent
    • Content structure
    • Header hierarchy
    • On-page optimization
  • Strong research skills and ability to work with reliable sources.
  • Excellent proofreading and editing skills.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to content quality.
  • Ability to work independently and manage tasks with minimal supervision.
  • Proactive mindset with the confidence to suggest improvements and clarify unclear requirements.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with CMS platforms, particularly:
    • Shopware
    • WordPress
  • Experience publishing and formatting website content, including:
    • Metadata
    • Internal linking
    • Images
    • Headings and content structure
  • Experience writing for external websites, online magazines, or industry publications.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted writing tools and the ability to use them responsibly while maintaining originality and content quality.

Soft Skills

  • Strong written communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management abilities.
  • Ability to balance quality and deadlines.
  • Curiosity and willingness to learn about new industries and subject areas.
  • Collaborative attitude and positive approach to feedback.

What We Offer

  • Flexible part-time engagement.
  • Opportunity to work with international clients across different industries.
  • Supportive and collaborative team environment.
  • Exposure to diverse content and SEO projects.
  • Potential for long-term cooperation based on performance and business needs.
